definitions.explanation: The way one behaves, especially in social situations.

examples.japanese: {行儀|ぎょうぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
{行儀|ぎょうぎ}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: To sit properly with good manners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦うち→内：01328_uchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{行儀|ぎょうぎ}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えた→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ほう→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's better to teach children to eat with good manners from a young age.

notes:
{行儀|ぎょうぎ} refers to manners and proper behavior.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {行儀|ぎょうぎ}がいい/{良|よ}い (to have good manners)
- {行儀|ぎょうぎ}が{悪|わる}い (to have bad manners)
- {行儀|ぎょうぎ}よく (properly, with good manners)
- {行儀|ぎょうぎ}{見習|みなら}い (apprenticeship for manners)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {行儀|ぎょうぎ}{作法|さほう} (manners and etiquette)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {行儀|ぎょうぎ}: manners (behavior)
- {礼儀|れいぎ}: courtesy, etiquette
- マナー: manners (loanword)
- {作法|さほう}: etiquette, manner
